title: Layered differential markers, audible summaries, and GPU-friendly series reduction
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Context:
We need a unified approach for showing short-term deltas and anomalies on dense time-series charts that is accessible, inexpensive to render on GPU-accelerated canvases, and compatible with Redwood's token system for color/contrast. The current mini-series legends and tooltips struggle with: overlapping change markers, noisy SR output when many annotations exist, and high CPU on mobile when downsampling and computing diffs in JS.

Goals:
- Design a visual language for "layered differential markers" that conveys per-series and cross-series deltas without adding heavy DOM nodes.
- Provide an ARIA-first audible summary pattern (single-line SR brief + optional detailed panel) to avoid verbose SR readouts for each marker.
- Define token-compliant color/contrast variants and a compact contrast-pair for delta markers (increase/decrease/steady).
- Specify a render-friendly decimation strategy (GPU-friendly series reduction) that offloads as much work as possible to the renderer and avoids per-point JS allocations.

Constraints and trade-offs considered:
- Must not change existing chart API surface for customers; these are opt-in enhancements on the component side.
- Audible summaries should be short (<=2 phrases) with an option to expand into a detailed SR list for power users.
- Decimation must preserve visual anomalies (spikes) even when sampling aggressively. We prefer a prioritized-preservation decimator rather than naive averaging.

Design deliverables & acceptance criteria:
1) Visual spec: SVG/Canvas sketches for layered markers at 3 sizes (compact, regular, zoomed). Acceptance: markers are visibly distinct from series strokes at 4:1 contrast and pass AA contrast for both light/dark tokens.
2) Accessibility pattern: ARIA snippet + audible summary copy templates and expanded SR flow. Acceptance: SR summary length <= 200 chars; on test pages, NVDA/VoiceOver read the summary and allow expansion with a single keystroke.
3) Performance guide: recommended decimation algorithm, GPU-friendly geometry batching notes, and expected CPU/token reduction metrics. Acceptance: internal perf harness shows >=30% CPU reduction on 10-series, 60k-point timeline when decimation enabled.
4) Legend/tooltip behavior: hover/focus interaction map that prefers single shared tooltip for dense points and announces marker context succinctly. Acceptance: no more than 1 new DOM node per chart for markers; tooltips must show delta summaries without listing every marker.

Non-goals:
- Rewriting the renderer. We'll provide patterns for engine teams rather than implementing low-level kernels here.
- Changing public API for advanced customers unless explicitly discussed with Platform API team.

Artifacts and links:
- High-fidelity mockups: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qExampleLayeredMarkers
- Confluence spec draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DS/pages/Layered+Markers+Design+Spec
- Prototype (Figma): https://www.figma.com/file/abcdef/Layered-Markers-Prototype
- Perf harness dashboard: https://grafana.redwood-internal/charts/series-decimation-comparison
- Implementation PR (stub): https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-console/pull/3124

Success metrics:
- Accessibility: pass manual VoiceOver/NVDA checklist and automated axe snapshot for 3 representative datasets.
- Performance: 30%+ CPU improvement in internal harness, 20% lower tail latency on chart interactions for 10-series views.
- Adoption: primary line teams opt into flags for new marker style in 3 weeks after release and report reduced support tickets for "noisy SR output".
updates: 2026-02-19: Kickoff review with Eng (runtime) and Platform API. Agreed this will be implemented as an opt-in layer property; no API change required.
2026-02-25: First sketches delivered to Figma; engineering reviewed and requested explicit preservation rules for extreme spikes.
2026-03-02: Accessibility review with SRE/Accessibility team. Recommended an abbreviated summary template and keyboard shortcut to expand details.
2026-03-08: Prototype tested with NVDA and VoiceOver; summary reads correctly but expansion action needed a11y-friendly verb wording — updated copy.
2026-03-10: UX review signoff for visual tokens; waiting on ENG-80123 for decimation implementation ETA.
